# generated by scripts/changelog.ts from the CHANGELOG.md files of the packages
version: 0.10.0
date: 2026-10-27
---

### Added

- Add a report for images and file links whose file is missing or not processed yet: the link check (build and `ginko check`) lists them like broken links, and dev prints one warning per file. ([#71](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/71))
- Add forwarding for platform pages whose address an owner changed in the Studio: the old address answers with a 301 to the new one. ([#76](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/76))
- Add `ginko prepare-import <folder> --map <map.json>`: turns a folder in the export format, filled from an old site, into one that Lupinum can import (downloads images, renames Markdown components, writes redirects). ([#75](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/75))

### Changed

- Change `import` to wait until the imported images are processed and to fail with the list of images that failed or timed out; `--no-wait` keeps the old behaviour and `--wait-timeout <seconds>` sets the limit. ([#69](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/69))
- Change images from the platform to load from the site's own address (`/__ginko/file/…`) instead of the storage host, so a backend move cannot break images in caches and search results; JSON-LD image addresses are now absolute. ([#73](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/73))

### Fixed

- Fix a Vercel production build without `NUXT_PUBLIC_GINKO_PLATFORM` passing and shipping a site that answers 503: it now stops with a clear error (other builds only warn). ([#70](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/70))
